name: Life Back Then
summary:
Travel back in time and experience Singapore’s history from a whole new perspective in Life Back Then.

Choose between two unique life paths, each featuring its own environment, story and interactive VR challenges.

Take on the role of a coolie and experience the demanding work that supported Singapore’s early ports and trade. Test your speed and coordination by sorting fish into the correct containers, or grab a shovel and move coal before time runs out.
